description: Flat metadata schema for patient-level next-generation sequencing records from rare genetic disorder studies, including clinical phenotype, consent, biosample handling, sequencing, and variant analysis metadata.

record_id.descr: Unique internal identifier for this patient-level metadata record.

participant_code.descr: Pseudonymized participant identifier used across clinical, sample, and sequencing records.

family_id.descr: Identifier linking related participants from the same family or pedigree, if applicable.

study_site.descr: Name or code of the recruiting clinical site or healthcare institution.

country_of_recruitment.descr: Country where the participant was recruited or sampled.

participant_sex.descr: Biological sex or sex assigned at birth, using controlled categories where possible.

participant_age_at_enrollment_years.descr: Age of the participant at enrollment in years.

participant_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or clinically recorded ethnicity, if collected.

participant_ancestry.descr: Reported ancestry or population background, if collected.

clinical_diagnosis.descr: Primary rare disorder or suspected clinical diagnosis associated with the sequencing request.

phenotype_summary.descr: Free-text summary of key clinical features and symptoms relevant to interpretation.

hpo_terms.descr: Human Phenotype Ontology terms recorded for the participant, preferably as a semicolon-separated string of HPO identifiers and labels.

disease_onset_age_years.descr: Age at first symptom onset in years, if known.

family_history_present.descr: Indicates whether a family history suggestive of inherited disease was reported.

consent_obtained.descr: Indicates whether informed consent was obtained for genomic analysis and data use.

consent_type.descr: Type of consent obtained, such as broad research consent, disease-specific consent, or tiered consent.

consent_date.descr: Date on which informed consent was signed or documented.

consent_allows_data_sharing.descr: Indicates whether the consent permits controlled or open sharing of genomic data.

consent_data_access_level.descr: Permitted access level for the data, such as open, controlled, embargoed, or restricted.

deidentified.descr: Indicates whether direct personal identifiers were removed or replaced with pseudonyms.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biological sample used for DNA extraction and sequencing.

sample_type.descr: Sample type, typically blood for this workflow, but can include other biospecimens if applicable.

sample_source_tissue.descr: Specific tissue or body source of the sample, such as peripheral blood.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date the biological sample was collected.

sample_collection_method.descr: Method used to obtain the specimen, such as venipuncture.

sample_volume_ml.descr: Volume of collected sample in milliliters.

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature of the sample in degrees Celsius prior to processing.

sample_transport_condition.descr: Transport conditions used for moving the sample to the processing laboratory.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Protocol or kit used to extract DNA from the sample.

dna_extraction_date.descr: Date on which DNA extraction was performed.

dna_concentration_ng_per_ul.descr: DNA concentration in nanograms per microliter.

dna_purity_260_280.descr: DNA purity ratio measured at 260/280 nm.

dna_integrity_metric.descr: DNA integrity measurement, such as DIN, RIN-like metric, or gel-based quality score.

library_preparation_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used before sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, or equivalent.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy, such as whole-genome sequencing, whole-exome sequencing, or targeted panel.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or flow cell.

sequencing_date.descr: Date sequencing was performed or completed.

raw_data_file_name.descr: Name or accession of the raw sequencing data file, such as FASTQ file or archive identifier.

reference_genome.descr: Reference genome build used for alignment, such as GRCh37 or GRCh38.

alignment_tool.descr: Software used for read alignment or mapping.

variant_caller.descr: Software used to identify genomic variants.

analysis_pipeline_version.descr: Version of the bioinformatics pipeline used for variant detection and annotation.

analysis_completed.descr: Indicates whether the sequencing analysis pipeline completed successfully.

mean_coverage_x.descr: Mean sequencing depth across the target region, reported as X-fold coverage.

target_coverage_20x_percent.descr: Percent of target bases covered at least 20-fold.

variant_count_total.descr: Total number of variants reported for the sample or participant.

pathogenic_variant_found.descr: Indicates whether at least one pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant was identified.

candidate_gene.descr: Primary gene implicated by the analysis, if applicable.

variant_genomic_coordinates.descr: Genomic coordinates of the variant, typically in chromosome:start-end format with reference allele context if available.

variant_class.descr: Variant class, such as SNV, indel, CNV, SV, or splice variant.

variant_clinical_significance.descr: Clinical classification of the variant, such as pathogenic, likely pathogenic, VUS, likely benign, or benign.

inheritance_pattern.descr: Observed or inferred inheritance mode, such as autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive, X-linked, or de novo.

validation_method.descr: Orthogonal validation method used for the reported variant, if any.

variant_reported_in_clinical_report.descr: Indicates whether the variant was included in a clinical report returned to the participant or clinician.

data_release_status.descr: Current release status of the record, such as internal use only, embargoed, shared, or public.

last_updated_date.descr: Date when the metadata record was last modified.
